title: House, DICT: No summon issued for Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg
summary: The House of Representatives and the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) have clarified that Congress never issued a call for Meta Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg…

blocks.text: The House of Representatives and the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) have clarified that Congress never issued a call for Meta Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg to appear before the plenary.
